verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report says RustDesk recognized two remote screens and let the user click 1 or 2 to choose which to show. That is monitor selection and switching within a session. No first-party documentation describes it, and nothing shows viewing a single window or app. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of multi-monitor switching, per-window/app view capability, evidence beyond two displays.

support.subject: As a power user, I can view a specific monitor, window, or app on a multi-display host and switch between them mid-session

citations.quote: It recognized two screens, let the user click 1 or 2 to choose which to show
